questions.subject: PHYSICS_EM
questions.topic: Why the centre of a Newton's pattern is dark
questions.learningObjective: Explain why the centre of a Newton's pattern is dark.
questions.stem: Phase reversal at the centre of a Newton's pattern, in radians?
questions.explanation: Reflection at the top surface undergoes a phase reversal, making the centre dark. The dark centre comes from that half-wave shift.
questions.hint: A denser reflector gives pi radians.

questions.subject: PHYSICS_EM
questions.topic: Why soap bubbles show colour bands
questions.learningObjective: Explain why soap bubbles show colour bands.
questions.stem: A clinician notes coloured bands on a soap film.

options.text: Varying film thickness creates interference for different wavelengths.
Colours come from dye in the soap.
Colours come from scattering by dust.
Colours come from temperature gradients.

questions.explanation: Varying film thickness creates interference for different wavelengths. Each thickness favours different colours.

questions.subject: PHYSICS_EM
questions.topic: What a Michelson interferometer compares
questions.learningObjective: Explain what a Michelson interferometer compares.
questions.stem: What does a Michelson interferometer compare?

answer.exemplar: It compares two optical path lengths using interference. The fringe pattern reveals their difference.

questions.subject: PHYSICS_EM
questions.topic: Fringes counted for a mirror movement
questions.learningObjective: Explain fringes counted for a mirror movement.
questions.stem: Mirror moves 0.10 mm at 500 nm; fringes counted?
questions.explanation: Each fringe corresponds to a mirror movement of lambda over two, so count is two d over lambda.

questions.subject: PHYSICS_EM
questions.topic: Measuring a wavelength with an interferometer
questions.learningObjective: Explain measuring a wavelength with an interferometer.

questions.topic: Why one mirror gives twice the path change

questions.subject: PHYSICS_EM
questions.topic: Why the centre of a Newton's pattern is dark
questions.learningObjective: Explain why the centre of a Newton's pattern is dark.
questions.stem: Phase reversal at the centre, in radians?
questions.explanation: Reflection at the top surface undergoes a phase reversal, making the centre dark. The dark centre comes from that half-wave shift.
questions.hint: A denser reflector gives pi radians.

questions.subject: PHYSICS_EM
questions.topic: Why soap bubbles show colour bands
questions.learningObjective: Explain why soap bubbles show colour bands.
questions.stem: Coloured bands appear on a soap film.

options.text: Colours come from dye in the soap.
Colours come from scattering by dust.
Colours come from temperature gradients.
Varying film thickness creates interference for different wavelengths.

questions.explanation: Varying film thickness creates interference for different wavelengths. Each thickness favours different colours.

questions.topic: What a Michelson interferometer compares
questions.learningObjective: Explain what a Michelson interferometer compares.
questions.stem: What does a Michelson interferometer compare?

answer.exemplar: It compares two optical path lengths using interference. The fringe pattern reveals their difference.

questions.explanation: It compares two optical path lengths using interference. Small path changes move the fringes.
